definitions.explanation: A four-character compound combining 不平 (dissatisfaction) and 不満 (discontent) to express a general state of complaint or grumbling. Emphasizes persistent, accumulated dissatisfaction rather than a single complaint.

examples.japanese: {不平不満|ふへいふまん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不平不満|ふへいふまん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
{不平不満|ふへいふまん}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧にいたく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to be around people who do nothing but complain.

notes:
USAGE:
{不平不満|ふへいふまん} is a yojijukugo (four-character compound) that pairs two near-synonyms for emphasis. It describes chronic or accumulated dissatisfaction rather than a single, specific complaint.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不平不満|ふへいふまん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to voice complaints)
- {不平不満|ふへいふまん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漏|も}らす→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧ (to let slip one's grievances)
- {不平不満|ふへいふまん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{溜|た}まる→溜まる：02067_tamaru⟧ (for grievances to pile up)
- {不平不満|ふへいふまん}⟦だらけ→〜だらけ：18372_darake⟧ (full of complaints)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧ is a more casual, everyday word for a complaint or gripe. {不平不満|ふへいふまん} is more formal and suggests deeper or more widespread discontent.
